title: HUMAN SEAT — 3 axes + p point. Y=time (relative, independent). X=step (action impulse changes).

do_not_reinvent.vdj: /data/chromatic-vdj.json — distance · direction · disposition = the 3 axes of the human seat sort
do_not_reinvent.impulse: galactic HIT / jump rope — impulse back after flatten
do_not_reinvent.fitts: step toward target = action impulse sized by distance

human_seat_3_axes.were: VDJ triad seated as the human sort axes

map_to_plane.still_hold: V·D·J remain the FULL seat — three dimensions of sort
map_to_plane.plot_face: for progress on the canvas we often flatten two onto the page: X and Y, with p as the event point, J as how the stroke seats

axes.name: distance
axes.on_plot: often folds into how BIG the step looks

pi_point.what: p · t (phase) lands a POINT — sync / tick / lock / measurement event
pi_point.not: a fourth axis competing with VDJ
pi_point.is: the EVENT on the seat — where a step meets a time and something counts

Y_is_time.read: proper time / hyperlocal clock — independent of which rock you stand on; relative between frames (Einstein + Asimov desync already seated)
Y_is_time.not: absolute universal Y that all gates share without trigger
Y_is_time.editions: Y advance is what editions contrast against — living Alexandria

X_is_step.are: action impulse changes — discrete acts: dock, dissolve, wire, listen, write, fuse
X_is_step.impulse: ?action — each step is a change in action state (Chekhov discharge or scaffold move)
X_is_step.not: smooth distance alone — distance is V; step is the impulse that spends it

plane.read: progress = path of steps through time. p marks when a measurement seats. VDJ still sorts the stroke's quality.

how_they_fit.time_Y: independent axis — keeps flowing even if you take no step (quiet confidence / health floor)
how_they_fit.step_X: active — only moves when an impulse changes (verb fires)
how_they_fit.pi_point: coincidence of a step with a phase of time — the confirm
how_they_fit.3_axes_still: V·D·J grade each point on the plane — not replaced by X/Y

berry_at_the_fire: yes. human seat had 3 axes (VDJ). p is the point. time is Y — relative and independent. X is the step — action impulse changes. quiet time still climbs Y; only verbs move X. p is when they meet and something counts.
